epic.title: EPIC-003: Pipeline d'Analyse (Batch Execution)
epic.description: Le système exécute l'analyse sur tous les LLMs en parallèle via Kafka+Flink, enrichit les résultats, notifie en temps réel et par email. Inclut l'exécution hebdomadaire planifiée.

userStory.want: my report to start analyzing automatically after first-time configuration
userStory.so_that: I get results without manual intervention

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Flink polls every 90s with SKIP LOCKED, questions dispatched to Kafka topics per enabled LLM
LLM dispatchers send to Prompt API at calibrated rates, responses persisted to PostgreSQL then published to kafka-responses
LLM call fails after 3 retries: response saved with status=FAILED, published to Kafka, pipeline continues
Circuit Breaker opens for one LLM (>5% errors): only that dispatcher pauses 30s

database.migrations: llm_responses table with nullable snapshot_id column

userStory.want: to see my analysis progressing in real-time
userStory.so_that: I know the execution is advancing and which LLMs have completed

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SSE endpoint returns progress events with progress 0-100, completedModels, pendingModels
Flink counts responses via keyBy(reportId) + RocksDB, every ~10 responses publishes progress to kafka-report-status
Analysis completes: Editor receives status COMPLETED/COMPLETED_PARTIAL/FAILED
SSE reconnection: current state immediately, heartbeat 30s, max 5 connections/key, TTL 30min

technicalDetails.frontend: SseProgress component with per-LLM progress bars

userStory.want: the system to identify my top competitors from AI visibility results
userStory.so_that: competitive analysis uses real market data instead of placeholders

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Consume VISIBILITY_COMPLETE trigger from geo-enrichment-trigger Kafka topic
Enrich visibility with target_rank, is_mentioned, is_first, total_entities, mentioned_entities (JSONB)
Brand matching via Gemini AI (2-step: text similarity + AI grouping)
Extract top 5 competitors per market × category (mention count desc, avg position asc)
Replace [Competitor 1-5] placeholders in memory, dispatch Phase 2 to Kafka
Emit progress events 40→50% via geo-report-status
Edge cases: zero visibility questions, target absent, <5 competitors, Gemini failure (fallback)

technicalDetails.dataAccess: Entity name from reports table (authorized cross-service read)
technicalDetails.storage: In-memory placeholder replacement, text stored in llm_responses.question_text
technicalDetails.competitors: Extracted in memory (recoverable from enriched llm_responses)

stories.title: [Story 3.4] Perception Analysis & Reputation Insights

userStory.want: AI-generated reputation insights (concepts, sentiment) per category and market
userStory.so_that: I understand how AI engines perceive my brand

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Consume PERCEPTION_COMPLETE trigger, call PerceptionEnrichmentService
1 Gemini call per market × category (name, response_ids, quotes with sentiment_score)
Distribute concepts to responses via response_ids, store in perception_concepts JSONB
Store concept.name, sentiment_score, quotes[] (NOT frequency/sentiment label)
No progress events (parallel enrichment)
Edge cases: zero perception, Gemini failure (1 retry then skip), idempotent

pmDecisionsRequired: Exact Gemini prompt for concept extraction

userStory.want: competitive analysis completed and all citation sources classified
userStory.so_that: I can see my brand vs competitors and know which publications to target

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Flink extends ResponseCounter for Phase 2 (50→80% progress)
Emit CLASSIFY_SOURCES when all 3 counts at 100%
Competitive enrichment (target_rank, is_first) - 100% local
Extract sources from ALL responses, create response_sources rows
3-level classification (regex → cache → Gemini) with 11 categories
11 source categories with priority rules
Report finalization with PIPELINE_COMPLETE
Progress events 50→100%

stories.title: [Story 3.5b] Improvement Areas & Priority Source Targets Pre-Computation

userStory.want: improvement areas and priority source targets calculated during the analysis pipeline
userStory.so_that: the Actions Center loads instantly with pre-computed results

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: 8 improvement types: Visibility (4), Competitive (3), Reputation (1)
Global favorability >= 95%: clear all competitive improvements
Max 3 reputation items per category (highest severity first)
Results persisted to PostgreSQL
Runs after classification, before COMPLETED status
